scope: Portable no-added-noise training implementation; no formal training was executed for this release update
origin: Independent underwater-channel SGSSC adaptation; not official IJCAI authors code

historical_pretraining.selection: minimum fixed-subset validation MSE; earliest tie; evaluate step 0 and each 250 steps
historical_pretraining.training_mask: 70% time points; shared I/Q; continuing independent CPU RNG
historical_pretraining.validation_mask: fixed per base ID using original stable_seed convention

historical_classifier.encoder: all layers frozen and eval; complete IQ without masking
historical_classifier.readout: fresh original SGSSC multilayer attention readout
historical_classifier.selection: maximum full-validation correct count; earliest tie; evaluate step 0 and each 250 steps

portable_data_contract.manifest: manifest.json with schema=sgssc-clean-data-v1, split=train|val, noise_mode=none_added, class_names in fixed 11-class order
portable_data_contract.base_ids.npy: Unicode [N], unique; training and validation sets must be disjoint
portable_data_contract.labels.npy: int64 [N] in [0,10], opened only for classifier stage
portable_data_contract.classifier_train_subset: externally preselected and ordered; N must equal round(training_pool_size * label_fraction)

adaptations: Standalone memory-mapped NPY inputs replace original project HDF5 readers and selection manifests. Users must supply correctly split no-added-noise reference windows and a preselected label subset.
Default update counts, optimizer, mask semantics, seed streams, checkpoint validation criteria, and earliest-tie rules are retained.
Frozen classification features are cached as NPY, replacing historical HDF5 caches.
Historical presentation dashboards and additional training-monitor diagnostics are omitted; they do not determine checkpoint selection.
Checkpoints use tensors/primitives and weights_only=True. Classifier best.pt and last.pt are accepted by the existing inference loader. No automatic resume is implemented.
New runs on externally supplied data are not asserted to reproduce published weights or scores exactly.

coverage: both encoder and spectrum head receive gradients
fixed validation masks follow sample IDs
test split and added-noise manifests rejected
train/validation overlap rejected before output creation
two-step stages, parameter updates and frozen encoder
validation best selection and safe checkpoint reload
classifier outputs match existing inference loader
label budget count and output overwrite rejection
undeclared or noisy pretrained sources rejected; missing-field compatibility limited to the audited legacy SHA256
